From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-08T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC timeline & success criteria - Zenotech

Hi Sofia — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call so we have a mutual action plan for the POC: 

1) Success criteria (agreed on call)
- Latency: median < 200ms for 2k token prompt profile (baseline workload)
- Throughput: support 20 concurrent sessions w/ sub-3s response times for short prompts
- Quality: scoring >= 85% on the 50-sample eval set (we can share format)
- Stability: zero crashes and <1% error rate over a 48-hour soak run

2) Evaluation plan
- Redwood provides a baseline deployment and an eval harness (scripts + sample prompts).
- Zenotech to supply 50 representative prompts + 3 eval users and expected success labels by Fri 3/12.
- We will run baseline + optimized configs and share raw metrics and a short readout.

3) Timeline (proposed)
- Kickoff call: week of Mar 15 (we suggested Tue 3/16 or Wed 3/17)
- Week 1 (3/16–3/22): environment setup, network & credential exchange, test account created
- Week 2 (3/23–3/29): baseline runs + quick tuning pass
- Week 3 (3/30–4/5): soak & stability testing
- Final readout: week of Apr 12 (detailed results + recommendations)

4) Ownership
- Redwood: Marissa (sales/POC manager) — overall coord + readout; Dylan (solutions) — integration & perf tuning; Dev (infra) — setup and network support.
- Zenotech: Sofia — project lead; Ethan — engineering contact; Zenotech IT — firewall/network team.

5) Immediate next steps (action items)
- Sofia: confirm kickoff date preference and share the 50-sample eval prompts by 3/12.
- Zenotech IT: contacts for firewall rules & CIDRs (we attached Network_Requirements.pdf).
- Redwood: share POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (attached) and Calendly for kickoff scheduling.

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx, Network_Requirements.pdf

If this looks right I’ll lock the kickoff for Tue 3/16 10:00am PT (openslot in my calendar) and add weekly Wed check-ins. Please reply with any edits or confirm.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap and thanks for the clear owners. A few quick clarifications before we confirm kickoff: 

- The 50-sample eval set: can you share the expected format (CSV with prompt/expected label?) and an example row?
- For the latency spec: are you measuring end-to-end (client->Redwood->client) or server-side token generation only? We have to compare against our existing in-house baseline.
- Network: can you confirm whether we need specific ports open outbound or if the deployment will be in our VPC with an inbound tunnel? Our IT team (cc'd) prefers clear rules before 3/12.

Also, 3/16 at 10am PT should work for us but Ethan has a recurring meeting that day — would 3/17 11am PT also be an option?

Appreciate it — will get the prompts to you by EOD Fri if you can confirm the format.

Best,
Sofia Ramos

Hi Sofia — great questions. Answers below and updated plan.

- Eval format: CSV with columns [prompt_id, prompt_text, expected_label, notes]. Example row attached in POC_Success_Criteria.xlsx (we included a sample).
- Latency measurement: we’ll provide both server-side generation latency and end-to-end request timing measured from a synthetic client in your region. For the POC acceptance criteria we’ll prioritize end-to-end median latency, but include server-side breakdowns in the readout.
- Network: typical setup is outbound-only TLS to Redwood-hosted endpoints (no inbound tunnels). That said, for Dedicated/private testing we can do VPC peering or SSH tunnel as needed. See Network_Requirements.pdf (attached) for CIDRs and ports (primarily 443 outbound). Please have your IT confirm whether outbound-only works; if not we’ll schedule a short network call.

Updated timeline & preferences:
- Kickoff: Wed 3/17 11:00am PT (proposed) — Dylan & Dev will join.
- Weekly check-ins: Wed 11:00am PT starting 3/24 (30 min) to review progress and blockers.
- Final readout: Tue 4/13 10:00am PT (we pushed one week to allow soak).

Action items updated:
- Sofia: share CSV by Fri 3/12 (Marissa to follow up if not received).
- Zenotech IT: confirm outbound 443 allowed to redwood.ai CIDRs or request network call by 3/12.
- Dylan: prep integration checklist and confirm resource windows for baseline runs.
- Dev: prepare temporary test account and ensure infra ops are available for the kickoff.

Scheduling: here’s my Calendly link to confirm kickoff if 3/17 works: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/zenotech-poc-kickoff

If that all looks good I’ll send the official invite and include a short agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa
